Different block granularity and a different scale format give different quantization error, so an MXFP4 version of one of these problems is a re-specification, not a translation, and must never be presented as the NVFP4 problem.
deferred.revisit_when: ROCm gains a block-16 FP8-E4M3-scaled scaled_gemm path, or the benchmark adds MXFP4 problems under their own IDs with provenance back to these.
